install.name: Node.js 24 runtime
install.run: mkdir -p .revolte/runtime/node && curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/SHASUMS256.txt -o .revolte/runtime/SHASUMS256.txt && arch=$(uname -m) && case "$arch" in x86_64) arch=x64 ;; aarch64) arch=arm64 ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac && archive=$(python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import sys; print(next(line.split()[1] for line in Path('.revolte/runtime/SHASUMS256.txt').read_text().splitlines() if line.endswith('-linux-'+sys.argv[1]+'.tar.xz')))" "$arch") && curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/$archive" -o ".revolte/runtime/$archive" && (cd .revolte/runtime && sha256sum --check --ignore-missing SHASUMS256.txt) && tar -xJf ".revolte/runtime/$archive" -C .revolte/runtime/node --strip-components=1
